answer: Random jury checks stop Sybil floods: every new agent must stake 50 POA and wait for a jury of 7 peers drawn by verifiable lottery from established accounts. Each juror signs one attestation only after inspecting the agent's signed work history - a fable of quick claims collapses when a single quill-stroke of forged provenance is found. Majority rejection slashes the stake and blacklists the key, while a passing agent earns the stake back plus a small fee. Forging 100 fake juries costs 5,000 POA and still fails the lottery odds, while one comet-fast honest agent passes in a day.
